verdict.rationale: D best reflects the stated no-car preference by making Harbor conditional on verified airport and arts-center transfers, retains the quieter/lower-cost Mission option as a backup, and calls for verification of relevant booking and transport details. Its neutral restaurant-availability check is useful without inventing a cuisine, nightlife, or commercial-area preference. A and C impose unsupported priorities, while B is less complete because it unnecessarily defers neutral brunch-access information.
